record_type_quote: In the present study, we aimed to evaluate the applicability and robustness of a previously proposed MASLD clustering model in NHANES III. Specifically, we sought to firstly validate the liver-and cardiometabolic-predominant clusters, explore novel subtypes via partitioning around medoids (PAM) clustering, assess the stability of individual assignments, examine the uncertainty and reproducibility of this data-driven clustering strategies, as well as their associations with all-cause, cardiovascular-, and diabetes-specific mortality.

targets.authors: Raverdy V, Tavaglione F, Chatelain E, et al.
targets.title: Data-driven cluster analysis identifies distinct types of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease

targets.outcome_quote: Our study highlights that the MASLD clusters defined in the original analysis could only be partially reproduced in an independent cohort. Although we identified analogous subtypes, individual assignment to these clusters was inconsistent between validation and replication, especially between the cardiometabolic and liver-specific groups.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Overall partial replication verdict: analogous clusters identified, individual assignments inconsistent.
